definition: Abase means to lower someone's dignity on purpose — pushing a person down in their own eyes or the world's.
task: Write one sentence of your own using the word abase. Make the sentence show what the word means -- a reader who did not know abase should be able to work it out from your sentence.

To degrade is to lower worth or condition, often gradually — a reputation, a road surface, even a signal can degrade over time. To abase is sharper and personal: one person's dignity deliberately pushed down, usually in public. Degradation can happen by neglect; abasement is engineered.

To demean someone is to treat or speak to them as less than they are — a demeaning chore, a demeaning tone. Abase goes further and more publicly: it strips a person's standing on purpose, lowering them in their own eyes or the world's.
